v1.25.4a (6 July 2024) |feed_title = 🔥 CHALLENGE MAPS 🔥 |previous_update = [[v1.24.0]] |next_update = [[v1.26.0]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.25.0''' is the seventy-ninth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 21st of June 2024. It featured the [[Ace Pilot]] rework and the [[PVP Test]]. This update was also given the name '''Challenge Maps Update''', as this update added [[Challenge Maps]]. This update encompassed eight updates, the main '''v1.25.0''' update (21 June 2024) and seven minor updates, v1.25.1 (23 June 2024), v1.25.1a (24 June 2024), v1.25.2 (26 June 2024), v1.25.3 (27 June 2024), v1.25.3a (4 July 2024), v1.25.4 (4 July 2024) and v1.25.4a (6 July 2024). ==Additions== ===Crates=== :In '''v1.25.4''' *One new skin for the [[Deluxe Crate]] **[[Commander]]: {{Color|Deluxe|Patriotic}} ===Challenges=== *[[Back to Basics (Challenge)|Back to Basics]] *[[Jailed Towers (Challenge)|Jailed Towers]] *[[Juggernaut (Challenge)|Juggernaut]] *[[Legion (Challenge)|Legion]] *[[Oops! All slimes!]] *[[Vanguard (Challenge)|Vanguard]] ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Challenge Maps]] *[[PVP Test]] *[[Juggernaut (Modifier)|Juggernaut]] modifier *[[Jailed Towers (Modifier)|Jailed Towers]] modifier *[[Back to Basics (Modifier)|Back to Basics]] modifier *[[Legion (Modifier)|Legion]] modifier *[[Oops all slimes!]] modifier *[[Vanguard (Modifier)|Vanguard]] modifier *[[Hardcore ==Changes & Bugfixes== ===Towers=== *[[Ace Pilot]] all skins' appearance changed. *[[Ace Pilot]] reworked. **Rotating it no longer has an impact on its starting position, though it does affect the rotation of the Figure8 flight path. **Now it can select from two flight paths, Circle and Figure8. **No longer has a startup animation on placement, Level 3 or Level 5. **Now bypasses defense. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|500}} to {{Money|550}}. ****Damage increased from 1 to 2. ****Firerate increased from 0.175 to 0.2. ****''Toggle Reverse'' ability added. *****Allows it to fly in the reverse direction of its flight path. ***'''Level 1''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|300}} to {{Money|150}}. ****Damage decreased from +1 to +0. ****Firerate changed from 0.175 to 0.2 > 0.175. ****Name changed from ''Better bullets'' to ''Greased Guns''. ***'''Level 2''' ****Bomb cooldown decreased from 4.5 to 4. ****Now unlocks the Figure8 flight path. ***'''Level 3''' ****Damage increased from +2 to +3. ****No longer boosts flight speed. ****Bomb damage increased from 15 to 18. ****Bomb cooldown decreased from 4.5 to 4. ****Bomb explosion range increased from 4 to 4.5. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|3,200}} to {{Money|3,600}}. ****Damage increased from +2 to +3. ****Firerate changed from 0.15 to 0.15 > 0.125. ****[[Hidden Detection Buff]] is now permanent. ****[[Hidden Detection Buff]] is now given in its secondary range around the runway, which has a range of 7. ****Bomb damage increased from 15 to 25. ****Bomb cooldown decreased from 3 to 2.75. ****Bomb explosion range increased from 4 to 4.5. ***'''Level 5''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|8,750}} to {{Money|9,750}}. ****Firerate changed from 0.15 > 0.1 to 0.125 > 0.117. ****Flight speed boost changed, now boosts flight speed by 35%. ****Bomb damage increased from 20 to 30. ****Bomb cooldown decreased from 2.5 to 0.65. ****Bomb explosion range decreased from 5.5 to 4. *[[Ace Pilot]] no longer displays as a tower pet. *Fixed [[Ace Pilot]] not dealing any damage to enemies with its gun while its bomb is being dropped. *[[Paintballer]]'s {{Color|Premium|Green}} skin Level 0-5 appearance changed. *[[Units]] now have dots under them when their respective towers are selected. *Fixed {{Color|Other|Spring Time}} [[Commander]] skin not having custom [[Gunner APC]] and [[Missile APC]]s. *Fixed [[Warden]] not showing the [[Pizza Party]] icon in its description when it is not unlocked. :In '''v1.25.2''': *Partially fixed towers not gaining hidden detection when upgraded to a Level that has one if they had the [[Hidden Detection Buff]] active and later removed. While this issue still happens, if the tower that lost their hidden detection through this bug is updated again they will gain their hidden detection back. ===Enemies=== *[[Normal]] send stats {{Money|260}}. **Send cooldown increased from 4 to 6. *[[Hidden Boss]] send stats changed. **Send cost increased from {{Money|400}} to {{Money|480}}. **Send cooldown increased from 3 to 4. *[[Slow Boss]] send stats changed. **Send cost increased from {{Money|150}} to {{Money|210}}. **Send cooldown increased from 2 to 4. *[[Breaker4]] send cooldown increased from 2 to 3. *[[Tank]] send cooldown increased from 1 to 4. *Fixed [[Quick]] dealing wrong amount of damage to the base health while [[Enemies Beta]] increases its health to 6. ===Maps=== *Updated icons for [[Badlands II]], [[Pizza Party]] and [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. *Fixed [[Pizza Party]] not displaying its map icon. *Fixed [[Pizza Party]] playing the [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode music instead of its own. ===Miscellanous=== *Special gamemodes [[Matchmaking]] statues are now combined into one statue. *All [[Matchmaking]] statues now have unique podiums and particle effects. **The beta billboard text is removed from all original statues. *Survival [[Matchmaking]] statue is now in the place of the original [[Badlands II]] [[Matchmaking]] statue. *Player count requirement for [[Lost Souls]] removed, now it can be activated in solos. *[[VIP Boost]] icon changed. *[[VIP+ Boost]] icon changed. *[[VIP Boost]] is no longer displayed if the [[VIP+ Boost]] is active, as [[VIP+ Boost]] now includes the [[VIP Boost]] {{Exp|}} boost. *Fixed ''Back From Infernal'' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]] count any kill from the [[Shotgunner]] as killing the [[Molten Boss]]. *Fixed [[PVP Test]] displaying negative minutes after timer reached zero, now it just disappears. :In '''v1.25.1''': *Fixed units dealing high amounts of damage to bloated enemies when their health is below 50%. :In '''v1.25.3''': *Fixed [[VIP+]] not providing a 10% {{Exp|}} boost to friends. *Fixed previous month on the leaderboards not displaying players with the most triumphs or {{Exp|}} in that month. :In '''v1.25.3a''': *[[Fireworks]]
